options.reason: The table is samples x protein abundances (12,622 features, mostly float64 log-scale abundance with frequent missingness in low-abundance proteins) plus a two-level integer label (1: 81, 0: 39), which matches the brief's binary ER-status prediction from proteomic data. Features are homogeneous protein measurements of a single sample type, so this is classification of rows, not representation. sample_id is a row key and must be excluded; no column is a component or recoding of ER status, and no subject/time structure exists for grouping or partitioning.
options.title: binary
